shared.data: o2022 fit slice via the executing preprocessor
shared.identical_within_family: same torch seed => identical initialization; same batch generator => identical batch order

solo_references: computed ONCE (control settings, single objective each), shared by every cell
reported_per_cell: objective probe-loss ratio joint/solo (final epoch, frozen probe)
weighted gradient share by objective (per epoch)
pre/post cosine distributions and projection frequency (combiner reports)
representation variance and contrastive effective negatives
material_degradation_definition: objective-family pair with joint/solo final probe-loss ratio > 1.2
winner_rule_lexicographic: 1) minimize the COUNT of materially degraded objective-family pairs
2) then minimize the WORST joint/solo ratio
3) then minimize the MEDIAN joint/solo ratio
tie_tolerance: equal counts AND ratio criteria within 0.02 -> INCONCLUSIVE (never broken by runtime)
forbidden: monitor and economic returns are never consulted; no post-hoc threshold or weight tuning; if NO cell removes material degradation -> M3 routing ablation is materialized as a NEW experiment
